Honestly, the fact that they raised guidance and beat the numbers on revenue while the market was panicking on after-hours volatility is the most bullish I've seen in a while. Jensen's team has actually been building a moat for years now, so I'm ignoring the noise and focusing on whether they can sustain the Blackwell ramp without burning cash. If they can keep the margins wide for 3 more years, I'm in.

Jensen is the only variable here and he seems genuinely excited about the Blackwell ramp, which tells me the moat is deep enough to survive the noise. I don't need to sell just yet, but I'm going to be watching the post-market volume closely for the next quarter to see if this 62% growth can sustain into FY2027 without a massive capex spike.
